title: Contested landing consumes per-path peer lists from get_commit_scope
description:
Objective: make the wrapper's contested-path landing act on the peer data that task-f943b6877b5f48aeb282d819f9da013d adds to moe.get_commit_scope. Each peerDeclared entry gains taskIds (every contributing nonterminal task, id order, taskIds[0] === taskId) and editingTaskIds (contributing tasks with an IN_PROGRESS plan step naming the path and an active session by the peerActive rule). Incident: completion e67ca0e (task-574c0b36, 06:22:35Z) landed the whole of docs/MCP_SERVER.md on its own TOOL witness while task-9cc13170 was mid-step-4 on that file. It swept 9cc13170's unfinished hunks (HEAD documented 2 unregistered tools until cd2160e9). Its Moe-Contested trailer named only the first claimant, the idle task-66e8d7d1.

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and its scripts/moe-agent.ps1 twin (string parity kept):
1. resolve_attribution (and the ps1 twin) builds, per path, the union of every entry's taskIds and of its editingTaskIds. A missing or non-list taskIds falls back to [taskId], and a missing or non-list editingTaskIds counts as []. An older daemon therefore lands exactly as today.
2. Under attribution.contested=skip-untouched, an own contested path with a non-empty editing list is skipped as MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_EDITING(<first editing task id>), even when this session's editing tool wrote it. This check runs before the TOOL and idle-peer checks. 'skip' keeps MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED, and 'commit' still lands.
3. Every contesting task is named:
   - the contested ledger (ATTR_DIR/contested, sent to record_commit as contested) has one row per (task, path);
   - a landed path gets one trailer line, `Moe-Contested: <path> (<id1>, <id2>)`;
   - held= names the peer of the hold.
4. attr_held_list and Get-MoeHeldList recognise MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_EDITING(...) and add a remedy sentence: a peer was mid-step, so coordinate, let its step finish, then re-edit with a witnessed tool, or let the peer's own landing carry the bytes.
5. The disk-fallback scope (daemon unreachable) builds taskIds from every contributing open task, and editingTaskIds from any IN_PROGRESS step naming the path. It has no activity data, so it fails closed.
6. Add postflight.{sh,ps1} scenarios, adding fake-proxy scope knobs in scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js if needed. Update the docs:
   - scripts/CLAUDE.md, Land on every exit / CONTESTED;
   - docs/CONFIGURATION.md, attribution.contested;
   - docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, the MOE_ATTR_* table;
   - docs/SCHEMA.md, the settings comment, if it still says a TOOL witness alone releases.

NOT in scope:
- Any daemon change. task-f943b687 owns get_commit_scope and record_commit, including record_commit's MOE_CONTESTED_HELD handling of MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_EDITING.
- Hunk-level staging.
- Changing the TOOL-witness, idle-peer or declare_files rules beyond the new editing hold.

Serialization: this task depends on task-f943b687 (the contract) and task-a2f243a1 (it has the same four wrapper files dirty now). Rerun the overlap scan before submit_plan:
- the CQ-V chain task-16bbf8ff -> task-2720c13b -> task-7f82e200 -> task-c4e076cd, and task-6f5cf10f, plan the same four files;
- task-b621ddc9 plans scripts/CLAUDE.md and docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

Verification: `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`, plus `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/postflight.ps1` where pwsh is installed.
definitionOfDone: postflight.sh: a TOOL-witnessed own contested path whose scope entry has editingTaskIds ["task-peer"] is skipped as MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_EDITING(task-peer), stays dirty, and the session-ended line carries held=<path>(task-peer) plus the editing remedy
postflight.sh: the same path with editingTaskIds [] and with the field absent lands exactly as before (legacy daemon parity)
postflight.sh: a landed contested path whose entry has taskIds ["task-a","task-b"] gets the single trailer `Moe-Contested: <path> (task-a, task-b)` and record_commit contested rows for both tasks
postflight.ps1 carries the same scenarios and passes under pwsh where installed
scripts/CLAUDE.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md document MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_EDITING and the per-task trailer list
taskRails: The editing hold only adds holds: never weaken the existing skip, skip-untouched, idle-peer or declare_files rules, and an older daemon's scope (no taskIds/editingTaskIds) must land byte-for-byte as today.
